title: A TBK1/ULK1 signalling axis couples lysosomal stress to TFEB activation.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Europe PMC record (PMID 42816627): not open access, no PMCID, no supplement, no text-mined accessions. NCBI elink from PubMed returned only related-PubMed links, no GEO/SRA/BioProject. PRIDE (proteomics archive) keyword search for TBK1/FNIP1/TFEB returned zero projects. No Zenodo/Dryad hit on the DOI.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Everything about the study comes from the abstract only: a mechanistic cell-biology paper (v-ATPase to TAX1BP1 to TBK1/ULK1 to FNIP1 S296 phosphorylation to TFEB nuclear translocation; ATP6V1B2 mutations in follicular lymphoma). No dataset size or format is described.

a1_downloadable.note: No deposited dataset found: no PMCID, no supplement listing, no GEO/SRA/PRIDE/Zenodo/Dryad records linked to the PMID or DOI. Checked repositories, not the paywalled full text.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No table exists; the likely outputs (western blots, imaging of TFEB nuclear localisation, phosphosite assays) are figure panels, not a labelled column.

a3_inputs_present.note: No inputs found in any repository.

a5_enough_rows.note: Mechanistic experiments on a handful of cell lines and mutants; no row count seen, almost certainly far below 400.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: No files to compare against the paper.

honest_claim_h3: No model claim is possible: the paper deposits no machine-learnable data that could be found.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use lysosomal pump mutations and cell treatments to predict whether the transcription factor TFEB moves into the nucleus.
plain_idea.train_on: Per-condition measurements of TFEB location under different mutations or drug treatments; number of examples unknown and no deposited table found.
plain_idea.predict: Fraction of cells with nuclear TFEB, which would come from microscopy in the paper's own experiments; not available as data.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Lymphoma researchers could rank patient v-ATPase (ATP6V1B2) mutations by how strongly they activate TFEB, but the data to train on does not exist publicly.

ml_idea: None viable: a mechanistic signalling paper with figure-panel results (blots, imaging) and no deposited omics or tabular data.

effort.cheapest_killing_check: Already done: PubMed elink, PRIDE and Europe PMC show no deposited dataset.

verdict_reason: Paywalled mechanistic cell-biology paper with no deposited dataset found in GEO, SRA, PRIDE, Zenodo or Dryad; no label table and far too few experiments for ML (fails A1, A2, A5).
